Description: El Nido is a nature-based Spanish immersion program designed for TK–1st grade students, and for children with early dismissal at Berkeley school district or Oakland school district and homeschoolers. Held entirely in a forest setting, Nido offers the perfect balance of language learning and outdoor exploration. Through songs, games, movement, and art, children practice Spanish while developing a deep connection to the natural world.In addition, Nido encourages children to become thoughtful stewards of the land, fostering a sense of respect, care, and responsibility for the environment and their communities.
